lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ኃድፈኒ እምተሰጥሞ ጌጋይ ክቡድ /2/
ናሁ በላዕሌየ ተንሥአ ሞገድ /2/
ኣድሕነኒ ንኸይጠፍእ ወዲቐ ብኃጢኣት /2/
ኣባይ ወሪዱ'ሎ ናይ ቁጥዓ መዓት /2/
[[/chorus]]

ኃድፈኒ ካብ ገሃነም ሓዊ ከቶ ካብዘይጠፍእ
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ዝኸፍአ ኣውራ ካብቲ ዘፍርሕ
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] መፈንጠራ ሓጢኣት ንዓይ ከይሕዘኒ
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ካብ ቤትካ ከይወጽእ ኣምላኽ ሓግዘኒ

ኃድፈኒ ካብ ዝወረደኒ ካብ ሽግር ካብ መዓት
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ካብ ዝፍረደሉ ካብ ዳግማይ ምጽኣት
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ናይ ኃጢኣት መገዲ ንኸየውድቐኒ
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] እግዚአብሔር ኣቦይ ንዓይ ደግፈኒ

ኃድፈኒ ካብ ሕሜት ካብ ስርቂ ካብ መግዛእቲ ኃጢኣት
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ካብ ጸልማት መገዲ ካብ ዘይብሉ ሕይወት
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ጐይታይ ዝሓዝነሉ ካብ ድፍረት ኃጢአት
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ካብ ተንኮል ካብ ቅንኢ ካብ ዘለዎ ክፍኣት

ኃድፈኒ ካብ ክፉእ ፈተና ካብ ዘማርረሉ
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ካብ ዝሙት ካብ ርኽሰት ፍቕሪ ካብ ዘይብሉ
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] ካብ ምግባር ኃጢኣት ንዓይ ሓልወኒ
[[highlight]]ኃድፈኒ[[/highlight]] እግዚአብሔር ኣምላኸይ ካብ ኵሉ ኣድሕነኒ
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Hadfeni ʾimteset'mo gegay kibud /2/
Nahu belaʿileye tensiʾa moged /2/
ʾAdhineni nikheyt'efʾi wediqhe bihat'iʾat /2/
ʾAbay weridu'lo nay qut'ʿa meʿat /2/
[[/chorus]]

Hadfeni kab gehanem hawi keto kabzeyt'efʾi
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] zikhefʾa ʾawra kabti zefrih
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] mefent'era hat'iʾat niʿay keyhizeni
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] kab betka keywetsʾi ʾamlakh hagzeni

Hadfeni kab ziweredeni kab shigr kab meʿat
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] kab zifredelu kab dagmay mitsʾat
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] nay hat'iʾat megedi nikheyewdiqheni
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] Egziabher ʾaboy niʿay degfeni

Hadfeni kab himet kab sirqi kab megzaʾiti hat'iʾat
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] kab tselmat megedi kab zeybilu hiywet
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] goytay zihaznelu kab difret hat'iʾat
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] kab tenkol kab qinʾi kab zelewo kifʾat

Hadfeni kab kifuʾi fetena kab zemarrelu
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] kab zimut kab rikhset fiqhri kab zeybilu
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] kab migbar hat'iʾat niʿay halweni
[[highlight]]Hadfeni[[/highlight]] Egziabher ʾamlakhey kab kulu ʾadhineni
